name: godot-agent-skills
description: Control layer for AI agents in Godot 4.x — hooks that inject the standing rules, gate structural .tscn/.tres edits, and enforce verify-before-done — plus scene-file surgery, a Godot 3->4 API guard, a studio layer (greenlight, scope, playtest, decision memory), and an art pipeline (art direction, asset production, asset review with a persistent registry). Composes with GodotPrompter and awesome-gamedev.
